RFC4456-8-1.note: Rejudged 2026-10-17 after 7af5edbb7f. RFC 4456 Section 8 read in rfc/full/rfc4456.txt: "This attribute is 4 bytes long and it will be created by an RR in reflecting a route." The commit changed checkReflectorWithdrawal (both tags) only in its last failure: the Established re-check now returns interoplab.WithSearchedOutput(errors.New(...), output), which always returns a non-nil error wrapping the same cause (output.go). Every condition is byte-identical: the positive still requires the exact injector-log token 800904<3 octets>03 (flags 0x80, type 9, length 4, the client's identifier) beside the CLUSTER_LIST token, requireNoEarlyReflectorWithdrawal still refuses a withdrawal before FRR is asked, and the negative still requires the byte-exact withdrawal body :02:0004180A14000000 (withdrawn length 4, 10.20.0.0/24, Total Path Attribute Length 0), so no ORIGINATOR_ID rides the withdrawal. The unit covers TestReactorForwardRRInjects, TestReactorForwardRRPreservesOriginator and TestForwardReflectionLeavesAWithdrawalUntouched are unchanged and keep the 2026-10-06 judgement: absent originator becomes exactly four bytes 10.0.0.1, a present one stays byte-exact, withdrawal and EOR stay untouched with an advertisement control. The interop units carry no discrimination record and the scenario was not rerun for this failure-text change, so question 2 for them rests on reading; the unit tests carry the precise assertions. Verdict unchanged.

RFC4456-8-2.note: Rejudged 2026-10-17 after 7af5edbb7f. RFC 4456 Section 8 read in rfc/full/rfc4456.txt: "When an RR reflects a route, it MUST prepend the local CLUSTER_ID to the CLUSTER_LIST.  If the CLUSTER_LIST is empty, it MUST create a new one." The commit changed checkReflectorWithdrawal (both tags) only in the text of its final Established failure, now wrapped by interoplab.WithSearchedOutput, which returns a non-nil error for the same cause; no condition moved. The interop positive still requires the exact token 800A04<3 octets>02, a newly created four-byte CLUSTER_LIST holding Ze's configured cluster-id (the empty-list clause), and the negative still requires the attribute-free byte-exact withdrawal. The prepend-onto-existing clause stays proven by the unchanged unit covers: TestReactorForwardRRInjects requires exact [1.2.3.2] and TestReactorForwardRRPreservesOriginator exact [1.2.3.2,5.5.5.5], so replacement, append, omission and a wrong local id all fail. The interop units carry no discrimination record and were not rerun for this failure-text change. Verdict unchanged.

RFC4456-8-3.note: negative asserts an existing ORIGINATOR_ID 9.9.9.9 survives reflection unchanged, which is the SHOULD NOT itself; positive shows creation when none exists

RFC4456-8-4.note: Sentence: ORIGINATOR_ID carries the BGP Identifier of the originator. TestRFC4456OriginatorIDIsTheOriginatorsBGPIdentifier separates the source address (10.0.0.1) from its BGP Identifier (10.11.12.13): the created ORIGINATOR_ID equals 10.11.12.13 exactly and is neither the address nor the reflector's id 1.2.3.2; an existing 9.9.9.9 is kept and not replaced by the neighbor's Identifier. The address/Identifier confusion the earlier verdict named would now go red. Observed-red records on reactorForwardRS both polarities. Old negative tag prose on TestReactorForwardRRInjects still describes 8-1.

RFC4456-9-1.note: Rejudged 2026-10-17 after 7af5edbb7f. RFC 4456 Section 9 read in rfc/full/rfc4456.txt: "In addition, the following rule SHOULD be inserted between Steps f) and g): a BGP Speaker SHOULD prefer a route with the shorter CLUSTER_LIST length.  The CLUSTER_LIST length is zero if a route does not carry the CLUSTER_LIST attribute." The commit changed checkClusterListLengthTieBreak only in the four assertion 8 and 9 failures, which now pass the BIRD route dump through interoplab.WithSearchedOutput (bounded excerpt) instead of printing it whole; each still returns fail(n, non-nil error) on the same condition. Assertions 11 (ze and BIRD agree), 12 (the agreed winner is the origin's path with no CLUSTER_LIST, the absent-as-zero case) and 13 (ze decided at step cluster-list-length, so no earlier step separated the paths and step g would pick the other path) are byte-identical, so the scenario still fails on a non-compliant selection. The unit covers TestBestPath_ClusterListLength (both tags) and TestClusterListEntries are unchanged: SelectBest and SelectBestExplain asserted on shorter-list win, absent-as-zero win, step f precedence and fall-through to step g; clusterListEntries pins absent and empty as zero. The interop unit carries no discrimination record and was not rerun for this failure-text change. Verdict unchanged.

RFC4456-x-1.note: TestReactorForwardRRInjects pins AS_PATH, NEXT_HOP, MED and LOCAL_PREF byte-identical after reflection, so any modification fails it; single-polarity annotated

RFC4456-x-2.note: asserts nil output for non-client to non-client and non-nil for non-client to client; tag polarity labels are inverted against the new quote, whose conforming case is reflection to a client
